invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null execution context to proceed with the insert operation.
A valid instantTime string is required to track the commit instant, and it is likely never empty or null at method entry.
The method expects the records list to be non-null in order to insert prepped records.
If preppedRecords is not null, its size is always non-negative.
If instantTime is non-null, it generally should not be just whitespace; a valid commit time should be well-formed.
